topic: Write a descriptive essay about exploring science(描写一次探索科学的经历)
genre: 记叙 / 描写文(descriptive essay with sensory details and dialogue)
source: 上外版选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 Writing:write a descriptive essay to share your experience of exploring science(用感官细节与对话描写一次探索科学的经历)。
prompt_cn: 你所在学校的科学社团下个月将庆祝成立四周年，邀请你写一篇英语短文，分享一次你探索科学的个人经历(可以是听的一次科学讲座、做的一个实验、参观科技馆、和朋友玩的科学游戏等)。要求:① 写清时间、地点和你做了什么;② 用感官细节(看到/听到/感到)和一句对话让描写生动;③ 表达你的感受。约100-120词。
prompt_en: Your school science society is celebrating its fourth anniversary next month. Write a short essay (about 100-120 words) sharing a personal experience of exploring science — a lecture you attended, an experiment you did, a visit to a science museum, or a science game you played. Make sure to: 1) say when and where it was and what you did; 2) use sensory details and at least one line of dialogue to make the writing vivid; 3) describe how you felt.
points: 交代时间地点与所做的事(Last week, our class visited …)
用感官细节让画面生动(I saw … / I could hear … / It felt …)
用一句对话增添真实感("That's so cool!" I said.)
结尾表达感受(I left with a feeling of joy and wonder.)
model_essay: Last week, our class visited a science fair, and I was so excited that I could hardly sleep the night before. The hall was crowded with students and bright with colourful models. What interested me most was a model of the human body powered by electricity. I could see the heart and lungs working clearly before my eyes. "That's so cool!" I said, leaning closer. The boy who had built it glowed with pride. "I'm always fascinated by how our body works," he told me with a smile. The whole place was full of amazing inventions and curious faces. I left the fair with a feeling of joy and wonder, and I made up my mind to bring my own model rocket next year.
model_translation: 上周，我们班参观了一个科学展，我激动得前一晚几乎睡不着。展厅里挤满了学生，到处是色彩缤纷的模型。最让我感兴趣的是一个用电力驱动的人体模型。我能清清楚楚地看到心脏和肺在我眼前工作。"太酷了!"我凑近说道。做模型的男孩满脸自豪。"我一直对身体如何运作着迷，"他笑着对我说。整个场地都是奇妙的发明和好奇的面孔。我带着喜悦与惊叹离开了科学展，并下定决心明年带上我自己的火箭模型。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:交代时间地点与所做的事 / 感官细节与对话 / 个人感受
围绕一次经历展开、按顺序描写、句句相关、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、-ing/-ed 形式作表语等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 开头交代 Last week, our class visited …
感官细节 I could see / hear / feel …
对话 "That's so cool!" I said.
结尾感受 I left with a feeling of joy and wonder.
key_expressions: I was so excited that I could hardly sleep the night before.
What interested me most was a model powered by electricity.
I could see the heart and lungs working clearly before my eyes.
I left the fair with a feeling of joy and wonder.

high_sentences: I was so excited that I could hardly sleep the night before.

error_pairs.note: 主语是事物用 -ing 形式作表语。

error_pairs.wrong: I was so exciting that I could not sleep.
error_pairs.correct: I was so excited that I could not sleep.
error_pairs.note: 主语是人用 -ed 形式作表语。

error_pairs.wrong: My dream is become a scientist.
error_pairs.correct: My dream is becoming a scientist.
error_pairs.note: 'dream is + V-ing' 用 -ing 形式作表语。
